0022600225.text: The Houston Rockets (7-3, 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, 6th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (7-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 5th in the West) in the Rockets' 12th game of the season, with Golden State riding a seven-game winning streak and Houston on a two-game skid after a 4-1 home record. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Golden State is missing Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Will Richard (thumb). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
